sentiment.label: risk_on
sentiment.reason_it: Il VIX a 16,61 (-20,26%) indica un mercato difensivo limitato; il S&P 500 è +1,58% a 7.688,62, segnale di forte risk‑on. Il DXY a 101,26 (-0,24%) è in debolezza, favorendo le commodity e gli EM. Il Brent a $94,06 (-0,59%) e il petrolio in calo rafforzano l’appetito per le azioni, mentre l’oro a $4.131,90 (+1,45%) resta in rialzo misto. In sintesi, la compressione del TLT (+0,80%) e il calo dei rendimenti USA (4,89% -1,17%) confermano la pressione al ribasso sui tassi reali, spingendo verso un contesto di risk‑on.
sentiment.reason_en: The VIX at 16.61 (-20.26%) signals limited defensive positioning; the S&P 500 is up +1.58% at 7,688.62, a clear risk‑on cue. The DXY at 101.26 (-0.24%) is weakening, which benefits commodities and emerging markets. Brent at $94.06 (-0.59%) and falling oil support equity appetite, while gold at $4,131.90 (+1.45%) shows a mixed rise. Overall, the TLT rise (+0.80%) and the drop in US 10‑year yields (4.89% -1.17%) confirm real‑rate compression, steering the market toward risk‑on.

Commodity: Brent -0,59% e DXY -0,24% creano un contesto bullish per le materie prime, mentre l’oro +1,45% resta neutro. articles.snippet: Butane prices are surging across the world. In Asia, the AFEI butane index stood at $1,180/t on November 3. US butane Belvieu prices have climbed to a 14-year high $920/t. This surge in prices reflects several overlapping trends, with the most significant being a reorientation of global propane/butane trade flows since the US-Iran war kicked off in March.…
